description: Durable attribution and rollups from ClickHouse only. Nothing on this dashboard reads Prometheus.

options.content:
### ClickHouse only
Database: `vllm_attribution`. Per-request rows land in **`request_events`** immediately. Window rollups land in **`request_metrics`** every **15s** (`metrics.emit_interval`). vLLM scrape rows land in **`vllm_system_metrics`** every **15s** (`vllm.metrics_scrape_interval`).

**Historical cost** panels derive USD from token sums and the **`gpu_usd_per_hour`** variable (same formula as live Prometheus: cluster throughput in the selected range → `$ / token` → team attribution). For live 10m gauges, use the **Prometheus** dashboard.

panels.description:
**Source:** ClickHouse table `request_events` — one INSERT per completed proxy request (`team_id` from `X-Team-ID`).

**Dump interval:** Immediate per request (not batched). Counts are `count()` per Grafana time bucket.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  team_id,
  count() AS requests
FROM request_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, team_id
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Requests per team

panels.description:
**Source:** ClickHouse `request_events` columns `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens` (parsed from vLLM JSON response).

**Dump interval:** Per request, immediate INSERT.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  team_id,
  sum(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens,
  sum(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens
FROM request_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, team_id
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Token usage by team

panels.description:
**Source:** ClickHouse `request_events` — `sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens)` for the dashboard time range.

**Dump interval:** Per request; panel aggregates across your selected time picker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  team_id,
  sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM request_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY team_id
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

panels.title: Total tokens in range (by team)

panels.description:
**Source:** `request_events` token sums for the dashboard time range + **`gpu_usd_per_hour`** variable.

**Formula:** extrapolate cluster tokens in range to tokens/hour, then `usd_per_million = (gpu_usd_per_hour / cluster_tokens_per_hour) × 1e6` (same idea as live `Calculator.USDPerMillionTokens()`).

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  toFloat64(${gpu_usd_per_hour}) AS gpu_rate,
  dateDiff('second', toDateTime($__fromTime), toDateTime($__toTime)) / 3600.0 AS range_hours,
  (
    SELECT sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens)
    FROM request_events
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND match(team_id, '${team:regex}')
  ) AS cluster_tokens
SELECT
  if(cluster_tokens > 0 AND range_hours > 0,
     (gpu_rate / (cluster_tokens / range_hours)) * 1000000,
     0) AS usd_per_million_tokens

panels.title: Effective $ / 1M tokens (range)

panels.description: **Source:** team token sums × range **`usd_per_token`**, where cluster tokens/hour is extrapolated from all traffic in the dashboard time picker (filtered by **Team**).

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  toFloat64(${gpu_usd_per_hour}) AS gpu_rate,
  dateDiff('second', toDateTime($__fromTime), toDateTime($__toTime)) / 3600.0 AS range_hours,
  (
    SELECT sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens)
    FROM request_events
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND match(team_id, '${team:regex}')
  ) AS cluster_tokens,
  if(cluster_tokens > 0 AND range_hours > 0, gpu_rate / (cluster_tokens / range_hours), 0) AS usd_per_token
SELECT
  team_id,
  round(sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) * usd_per_token, 6) AS estimated_cost_usd
FROM request_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND match(team_id, '${team:regex}')
GROUP BY team_id
ORDER BY estimated_cost_usd DESC

panels.title: Estimated cost in range (by team)

panels.description: **Source:** per-bucket team tokens × bucket **`usd_per_token`** (cluster throughput extrapolated from each Grafana time bucket).

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  toFloat64(${gpu_usd_per_hour}) AS gpu_rate,
  toFloat64($__interval_s) / 3600.0 AS bucket_hours,
  team AS (
    SELECT
      $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
      team_id,
      sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) AS team_tokens
    FROM request_events
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND match(team_id, '${team:regex}')
    GROUP BY time, team_id
  ),
  cluster AS (
    SELECT
      $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
      sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) AS cluster_tokens
    FROM request_events
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
      AND match(team_id, '${team:regex}')
    GROUP BY time
  )
SELECT
  team.time,
  team.team_id,
  if(cluster.cluster_tokens > 0 AND bucket_hours > 0,
     round(team.team_tokens * gpu_rate / (cluster.cluster_tokens / bucket_hours), 6),
     0) AS estimated_cost_usd
FROM team
INNER JOIN cluster ON team.time = cluster.time
ORDER BY team.time

panels.title: Estimated cost over time (by team)

panels.description:
**Source:** `LatencyRegistry` quantile stream → flushed to ClickHouse `request_metrics` as `latency_p50_ms`, `latency_p95_ms`, `latency_p99_ms` (not read from Prometheus here).

**Dump interval:** Every **15s** per team; stream reset after flush (`metrics.emit_interval`). One point per emit per team.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  team_id,
  latency_p50_ms AS p50,
  latency_p95_ms AS p95,
  latency_p99_ms AS p99
FROM request_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Latency percentiles (emit windows)

panels.description:
**Source:** `LatencyRegistry` TTFT stream → flushed to `request_metrics.ttft_p50_ms`, `ttft_p95_ms`, `ttft_p99_ms`.

**Dump interval:** Every **15s** per team. Non-streaming requests keep `ttft_ms = 0` and do not add TTFT samples.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  team_id,
  ttft_p50_ms AS p50,
  ttft_p95_ms AS p95,
  ttft_p99_ms AS p99
FROM request_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: TTFT percentiles (emit windows)

panels.description:
**Source:** `TotalCounter` in-memory window map → `request_metrics.total_requests` at flush (separate from Prometheus cumulative `gateway_total_requests`).

**Dump interval:** Every **15s**; window counter reset after INSERT. Prometheus counter is unchanged.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  team_id,
  total_requests
FROM request_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Requests per emit window

panels.description:
**Source:** ClickHouse `vllm_system_metrics` — gateway scrapes vLLM `/metrics` and inserts `running_requests`, `queue_depth`.

**Dump interval:** Every **15s** (`vllm.metrics_scrape_interval`). Not per-team.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  running_requests,
  queue_depth
FROM vllm_system_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Running vs queue depth

panels.description:
**Source:** ClickHouse `request_events` — per-row `latency_ms` and `ttft_ms` (TTFT > 0 only for `stream: true`).

**Dump interval:** Per request, immediate INSERT.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  team_id,
  model,
  prompt_tokens,
  completion_tokens,
  latency_ms,
  ttft_ms,
  status_code
FROM request_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50
